name: Dublin Place
summary: Dublin Place is a sprawling open-air shopping complex in Dublin, California, featuring a diverse mix of large and small chain stores alongside familiar restaurants. Anchored by major retailers like Target and PetSmart, the center serves as a convenient one-stop destination for East Bay families and residents.
demographics: Dublin Place attracts a diverse, family-oriented demographic from the rapidly growing Dublin and Tri-Valley area, with visitors typically representing middle to upper-middle income households. The trade area serves a well-educated population with strong household incomes, reflecting the East Bay's tech-influenced economy and suburban family composition. Primary shoppers include working professionals aged 25-54, families with children seeking convenient access to everyday necessities and dining options, and retirees drawn to the center's accessible layout and essential services. The center benefits from Dublin's position as a commuter hub with BART access, capturing both local residents and regional visitors seeking value-oriented shopping combined with national brand reliability.
description: Dublin Place stands as a prominent shopping destination in the heart of Dublin, California, offering a sprawling complex that combines convenience, variety, and community appeal. Located at 7200 Amador Plaza Road, this open-air center has established itself as a go-to destination for East Bay residents seeking a comprehensive mix of large and small chain stores alongside familiar restaurant options. The center's tenant roster includes major anchors like Target and PetSmart, complemented by diverse offerings ranging from Panera Bread for casual dining to BMO for banking services, and specialty retailers like Destination XL. With its accessible layout and ample parking, Dublin Place serves as a neighborhood hub where families can accomplish multiple shopping tasks in one convenient location. The center's tagline "Food. Fun. Enjoy." captures its mission to provide not just retail therapy but a complete lifestyle experience for the thriving Tri-Valley community it serves.
